# miniaudio provenance

MinecraftC vendors `miniaudio.h` version 0.11.25 from
https://github.com/mackron/miniaudio/releases/tag/0.11.25.

The accompanying upstream `LICENSE` offers a choice of public-domain or
MIT No Attribution terms. MinecraftC uses the MIT-0 option. The library is
used only for procedural weather playback; no upstream audio assets are
included.
